import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, free_slots, overlaps, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_unsorted_events():
    """Events may arrive in any order."""
    result = free_slots([Event(720, 780), Event(540, 600)], 480, 1020)
    # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 720=12*60, 780=13*60, 1020=17*60
    assert result == [(480, 540), (600, 720), (780, 1020)]


def test_issue_overlapping_events():
    """Events may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 700), Event(600, 650)], 480, 800)
    # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 700=11*60+40, 800=13*60+20
    assert result == [(480, 540), (700, 800)]


def test_issue_clipped_before_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(400, 500)], 480, 1020)
    # clipped [400,500) to [480,500); gap [500,1020): 1020=17*60
    assert result == [(500, 1020)]


def test_issue_clipped_after_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(900, 1100)], 480, 1020)
    # clipped [900,1100) to [900,1020); gap [480,900): 480=8*60, 900=15*60
    assert result == [(480, 900)]


def test_issue_outside_day_ignored():
    """Events entirely outside the day are ignored."""
    result = free_slots([Event(0, 100), Event(1100, 1200)], 480, 1020)
    # both outside [480,1020); free whole day: 480=8*60, 1020=17*60
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]


def test_issue_chain_merged_unsorted():
    """Overlapping unsorted events merge into one busy block."""
    result = free_slots([Event(600, 650), Event(500, 620), Event(640, 700)], 480, 800)
    # merged busy [500,700); gaps [480,500) and [700,800): 480=8*60, 500=8*60+20, 800=13*60+20
    assert result == [(480, 500), (700, 800)]


def test_issue_min_minutes_threshold():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(659, 700)], 480, 800, min_minutes=60)
    # gaps 540-480=60 kept, 659-600=59 dropped, 800-700=100 kept
    assert result == [(480, 540), (700, 800)]


def test_issue_empty_events():
    """Empty input leaves the whole day free."""
    result = free_slots([], 480, 1020)
    # no busy time; gap [480,1020): 480=8*60, 1020=17*60
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # [540,600) and [600,660) share 0 minutes => False
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False


def test_contract_shared_minute_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    # [540,600) and [590,660) share minutes 590-599 => True
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(590, 660)) is True


def test_contract_half_open_no_gap():
    """An Event covers the half-open interval [start, end)."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 480, 720)
    # back-to-back => no gap at 600; gaps [480,540) and [660,720): 480=8*60, 720=12*60
    assert result == [(480, 540), (660, 720)]


def test_contract_parse_time_valid():
    """parse_time turns HH:MM (24-hour) into minutes."""
    # 9*60+30=570
    assert parse_time("09:30") == 570


def test_contract_parse_time_invalid():
    """Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_time("not-a-time")


def test_contract_fmt_duration_examples():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm."""
    # 65=60+5 => 1h 05m; 45=0*60+45 => 0h 45m
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"
    assert fmt_duration(45) == "0h 45m"
